selection_information: complete declared TRAIN/VALID only; no TEST metric/prediction/diagnostic access

selection_rule.eligibility: all10 development cohorts finite and all stopping outcomes disclosed; method declared before campaign; scientific control-only recipes cannot be silently promoted
selection_rule.metric_scale: native metric in[0,1]; no cross-task average or dataset-independence claim
selection_rule.freeze_before_confirmation: selected cell, method source manifests, fixed native/settings, training controller, selected-checkpoint/evaluator/readout, all20cohort seeds and exact comparison family
selection_rule.cap_or_nonfinite: no hidden removal or retry; unresolved training prevents a quality claim, with all costs retained
selection_rule.no_eligible_positive_candidate: report exploratory results; do not manufacture a confirmation winner

confirmation.new_seeds: deterministic20cohort stream frozen after selected cell; must differ from recorded development/earlier fit seeds for that cell; no execution until seed collision audit passes
confirmation.claim_scope: repeat-training reliability conditional on selected dataset, split protocol, architecture, settings and controller; not new-data-population or universal-backbone superiority
confirmation.primary_metric: native source metric, direction greater is better
confirmation.primary_claim: candidate improves in more than half of independent training repeats against each of matchedM1, originalGNNM and nativeI4
confirmation.primary_test: one-sided exact binomial sign tests; ties/nonfinite/unresolved outcome are non-wins; fixed20 denominators; intersection-union p=max(p_M1,p_G0,p_I4)
confirmation.no_threefold_correction_for_joint_claim: intersection-union rejects only if all three component nulls are rejected; does not support selecting one favorable comparator
confirmation.scope_if_more_claims: multiple selected cells/candidates require a new frozen family and multiplicity correction before confirmation; no implicit expansion
confirmation.report: all paired scores/deltas; mean and SD; median; win/tie/loss; approximate paired-bootstrap mean-difference95% interval; exact sign p; cost and selection/convergence failures
confirmation.mean_interval_limit: bootstrap interval describes repeat-training variability approximately; not a guaranteed finite-sample interval or uncertainty over graphs/scaffolds
confirmation.mean_superiority_limit: sign test concerns probability of a positive paired difference, not a hypothesis about its mean magnitude
confirmation.TEST_release: only after immutable candidate/family/seed freeze and all checkpoint selectors finish; raw TEST access ledger required; TEST may not choose methods, epochs, readouts or settings
confirmation.prior_TEST_exposure: audit before primary freeze; previously inspected TEST data cannot be called untouched; repeat-seed evidence remains conditional and cannot remove historical dataset selection
confirmation.secondary_matrix: all unselected method/preset outcomes remain exploratory, with no post-hoc confirmatory p-value claims

sample_size_limit: 20 is a fixed prospective repeat budget, not a power calculation without an effect model; no promised significance or acceptance
